claude_proposed_widenings.name: revert_form
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: On a failed save, a shape-shifted creature reverts to its true form. No v4 atom exists for forced form reversion — the inverse of transform_target. end_ongoing_spells is too broad (ends all spells of a level range) and does not cover wild shape or non-spell shape-shifting. A dedicated revert_form atom is needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: if the creature is shape-shifted (as a result of the Polymorph spell, for example), it reverts to its true form

claude_proposed_widenings.name: suppress_shape_change
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: After reverting, the creature cannot shape-shift again until it leaves the cylinder. This is an area-scoped persistent suppression of a capability (shape-shifting). No v4 atom exists for suppressing form-change. The Condition type does not include a 'no shape-shifting' state. The suppression is tied to the area attachment (lifts on exit), which would require either a new Condition with area-exit expiry or a dedicated atom.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: can't shape-shift until it leaves the Cylinder

claude_proposed_widenings.name: on_creature_ends_turn_in_area
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Moonbeam's core ongoing threat fires at the END of each creature's turn in the area. The surface has on_attached_turn_start (fires at turn start) but no turn-end variant. Using on_attached_turn_start as a proxy is mechanically inaccurate — turn start and turn end are distinct resolution points. Same gap as Cloudkill.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature also makes this save when... it ends its turn there.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: once_per_turn_dedup on OngoingOperation
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell has three ongoing triggers (area moves into creature, creature enters, creature ends turn there) but a creature makes the save at most once per turn. No field on OngoingOperation allows expressing per-turn deduplication across multiple operations.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature makes this save only once per turn.
